# Priscilla Grant

[Academy](../codex/places.md#academy)

## Overview

- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Titles:** dream girl  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Priscilla Grant is a pale, spiritual-looking maiden. Despite her appearance, she is filled with mischief, pranks, and fun.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## Personality

Priscilla Grant is an ambitious, imaginative, and thoughtful student. Despite her pale and spiritual appearance, she is also full of fun, mischief, and pranks.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--priscilla-grant.md)

Priscilla and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) are intimate friends who form a close bond while attending Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy) together. They settle into their shared student life as classmates, alongside their friend [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md). During their time at the academy, Priscilla is part of Anne's social circle while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) balances her academic pursuits and visits with her acquaintance [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P7](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008), +1 more_
